About this site ##Background: I grew up in China before 18, and then I came to Canada for my undergraduation study. Before come to MDS, I was just an undergraduation student in McMaster Unversity, and worked as an Test Engineer intern in a game company for 1 year.##
##Why data science: This is because thie program can properly combine my learning in undergraduation study together, which is Computer Science and Statistics. What’s more, I am very interested in analyzing data with a scientific method. And this method can be applied into lots of scenarios in working.##
##Hobbies: I love running, playing footballs, and playing video games, such as Valorant, RainbowSix Seige, Stardew Valley and some other games.##

title: Duzhi Wu
text:
Hello everyone, this is Duzhi Wu, and you can call me David. I am from China, while I have my undergraduation study in Canada. I was studying in McMaster University, major in Computer Science and minor in Statistics. The reason why I choose data science as the program of my graduation study is because I am not interested in just coding. I love to analyze a group of data and to make a prediction of something might happen, with known of the probability calculation. Though data cannot totally make a decision for me, it at least can approximately show me a way.
